metadata.recentLowDefinition: 최신 10개 이용 가능 일봉(기준일 포함)의 최저 저가. 최저 저가가 기준일 전이고 기준일 종가가 저가보다 높아 저점 이후 반등한 종목
metadata.vwapDefinition: KIS 같은 일봉 응답의 거래대금(tamt) / 거래량(tvol)
metadata.priceSource: KIS Overseas Daily Price API; GET; 2026-10-20 UTC; one API response supplies the latest session VWAP and its same-source 10 daily bars
metadata.marketCapSource: latest stored instrument_fundamental_snapshots USD snapshot; source and observed/fetched timestamps included per item
metadata.requestSideEffects: Universe and fundamentals were read by SELECT; no candle/fundamentals cache save was called. The shared KIS request boundary invokes asynchronous diagnostic logging; rate-limit event writes reported the optional kis_rate_limit_events relation missing.; 718 additional direct KIS dailyprice GET-only requests for 20-bar RVOL; 455 calculated and verified latest volume equal to VWAP source, 263 returned HTTP 500 / EGW00201. No cache writes.
metadata.rvolDefinition: 기준 거래일 거래량 / 직전 20개 이용 가능 일봉의 평균 거래량 (기준 거래일 제외); 프로젝트 lib/daytrade-signal.ts 산식과 동일
metadata.rvolSource: KIS Overseas Daily Price API; GET; latest session 20261019. Each successful response latest volume was verified equal to the original VWAP scan latest volume.
metadata.rvolUnavailablePolicy: KIS HTTP 500 / EGW00201 response or missing/invalid baseline is excluded from the RVOL-qualified result and listed in notAssessed; no stale operating-cache RVOL substitutions.
